artwork_generation.method: deterministic native vector drawing for the icon and TV banner
artwork_generation.rights_basis: Original Gikundiro G and TV geometry using only system typography and solid/gradient colors; no club crest, photography, or third-party artwork.

feature_graphic.method: Project-owned icon and TV banner references were composed with image generation, then uniformly resampled from the exact 1024:500 source ratio to 1024x500 and checksum locked.
feature_graphic.normalization: Uniform resample only; no crop, content replacement, or transparency was introduced.
feature_graphic.rights_basis: Original project-owned Gikundiro geometry and generic system typography only; no club crest, photography, person, stadium, store badge, ranking, price, or third-party mark.

capture_provenance.capture_stage: same-TV-source validation-APK capture retained alongside production upload AAB
capture_provenance.signing_key_retention: The throwaway local-validation signing key was deleted immediately after the build; no production signing credential was used or retained.
capture_provenance.captured_state: Current release validation artifact service-unavailable state plus a current-app synthetic reveal/standings state; neither image shows a pairing code, QR payload, device credential, supporter identity, payment data, or production session data.
capture_provenance.capture_fidelity_boundary: Both images are genuine API 36 Android TV AVD renders of the current Flutter TV interface. The first comes from the release validation APK built from the same TV runtime source as the production upload AAB. The second comes from a non-shipping debug capture artifact that injected a deterministic synthetic projection through the app's existing preview-state boundary; its temporary entry point was deleted after capture. Neither is claimed as a Play-generated delivery APK capture, so exact Play-delivery visual parity remains open.
capture_provenance.recapture_drift: The final TV-only governance edit changed the validation APK and required an authoritative reinstall and recapture. The final service-unavailable screenshot remained visually equivalent and contains no live pairing, QR, supporter, or production-session data.

captures.data_boundary: No pairing code, QR payload, device credential, supporter data, or production session data.

captures.state_source: Deterministic synthetic TvRuntimeState injected through the existing RayonSportsTvApp previewState boundary; the temporary capture entry point was deleted after capture.
captures.data_boundary: Kinyarwanda synthetic question, choices, scores, and public aliases only; no backend request, pairing material, credential, real supporter data, payment data, or production session data.
captures.visual_review: Pass; no debug banner, overflow indicator, clipping, secret, credential, QR code, or personal data is visible.
